build_ChatGLMForCausalLM: build a ChatGLMForCausalLM inference model from a ChatGLMConfig with tensor-parallel support and quantization
create_GLMBlock: create a GLMBlock transformer layer with self-attention, MLP, RMSNorm or LayerNorm, and residual connections
run_ChatGLMM_forward: run the ChatGLMM forward pass with input_ids, position_ids, and forward batch to get hidden states
load_ChatGLMForCausalLM_weights: load HuggingFace ChatGLM weights into ChatGLMForCausalLM with support for rotary_pos_emb skipping and word_embeddings prefix handling
test_GLMAttention_forward: test GLMAttention forward pass with QKV projection, RoPE positional encoding, and RadixAttention for multi-query or grouped-query attention
